project_type: Next.js 16 fullstack app with App Router, real-time face emotion detection
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compiles and Next.js bundles correctly. No unit tests exist.
setup_instructions: npm install, then npm run dev for development
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js v22, npm available.
contribution_requirements: Follow Next.js 16 conventions per AGENTS.md. Use App Router patterns.
key_patterns: Client components with 'use client' directive. API routes in src/app/api/. Lib files in src/lib/. Components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS 4 for styling. Drizzle ORM with Neon PostgreSQL. face-api.js for client-side face detection.
directory_structure: src/app/ - pages and API routes (App Router), src/components/ - React components, src/lib/ - shared libraries (db, schema, emotions), public/models/ - face-api.js model files
